description: Mixed-domain routing set: questions WITHOUT a domain field and WITHOUT case details, so the router must decide from the wording alone. 'domain' is the expected domain; null means the question is ambiguous and the router should ask (clarify). Measures domain accuracy, misrouting (sent to the wrong domain) and clarification rate.
